msg_usage:
=== MESSAGE MANAGER ===========================================================

Gebrauch:

    [+!#]msgmanager blockmain <NICK>  -- blockt user main messages
    [+!#]msgmanager blockpm <NICK>  -- blockt user pm messages
    [+!#]msgmanager blockboth <NICK>  -- blockt user main + pm messages
    [+!#]msgmanager unblock <NICK>  -- unblockt user
    [+!#]msgmanager showusers  -- zeigt alle blocked users
    [+!#]msgmanager showsettings  -- zeigt settings aus der 'cfg.tbl'
   
=========================================================== MESSAGE MANAGER ===
